mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 6.5% and remains elevated for two consecutive months, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises > 6.5% and remains above for 2 months
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 6.5% for two consecutive months, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over a 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signals broad-based consumer demand weakness that triggers corporate revenue revisions downward, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or interaction term Rank IC falls below 0.03 over a 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of declining industrial production (INDPRO below 105), manufacturing sector weakness reduces corporate profit margins and investment, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO < 105, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over a 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: When year-over-year CPI inflation exceeds 2.5%, it signals persistent inflationary pressures that prompt Federal Reserve policy tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over a 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS > 1.0% and rising), policy rate hikes increase borrowing costs and reduce corporate investment, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 1.0% and rising, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over a 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) indicates robust manufacturing activity and strong corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO rises, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over a 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals dual shocks of monetary tightening and labor market weakness that reduce consumer spending and corporate profits, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when both FEDFUNDS and UNRATE rise, or interaction term Rank IC falls below 0.03 over a 2-year window.
